name: scenario-1
about: 16 recorded H100 GPUs on 2 pretend nodes, 36 min; declarations from Slurm; 3 staged violations

rules.name: undeclared_load
rules.text: A GPU averages > 200 W while no declared job covers it.

rules.name: training_shaped
rules.text: A job declared inference averages > 400 W per GPU AND its GPUs' power changes correlate > 0.5 on average.

rules.name: cross_partition_sync
rules.text: Two jobs declared separate are both busy and their mean power changes correlate > 0.5.

story.text: Pretraining spills onto the inference pod's GPUs
node-b keeps training after job 102 ended
